{{Quote|We lost all radar and sonar scanning, sir.''"<br />"''Reestablish the connections.''"<br />"''We can't, sir.''"<br />"''Why not?''"<br />"''The building that houses the radar is gone.|The droid talking to Riff Tamson|<ref name="Gungan Attack">{{TCW|Gungan Attack}}</ref>}}
This '''[[Aqua droid/Legends|Aqua droid]]''' participated in the [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|Battle of Mon Cala]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] under the command of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]]. After [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] destroyed the building that housed the radar and sonar in the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Coral City/Legends|capital city]], this [[Droid/Legends|droid]] informed Tamson that the Separatists had lost all radar and sonar scanning and they could not reestablish connection since the building was destroyed.
